usedFor: Lodgify knows your guests and bookings, and MailerLite keeps the email list, so “Create or Update Subscriber” adds a guest.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Status Changed to Booked” in Lodgify, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Only confirmed bookings reach the list, and a guest who is already subscribed is updated instead of duplicated.

watchOut: “Booking Change” in Lodgify fires whenever a booking is updated, so the same guest can reach MailerLite more than once.
